rows.ARS:

Exhibition name: Chandos Beauty
rows.Origin: Introduced in United Kingdom by R Harkness & Co. Ltd. in 2005 as 'Chandos Beauty'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, salmon-pink shading, pink highlights. Strong, cinnamon, clove, fruity, raspberry fragrance. 40 to 80 petals. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, spiral centers bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower, garden or hedge. Can be trained as a climber.
